source.description: Planner created '.23 depends on .1' (test depends on impl). Closing .1 should be unblocked, but operator hit 'py_backend-thm.3 blocked by [py_backend-thm.23]' when closing .3. There is an inverse 'implementation can't close while test is open' gate (test-planning convention?) that contradicts the dep direction. Solution today: bd close --force. Need: clear rule for whether tests gate impl close, and which direction the edge should be.
source.title: Test-issue dependency direction blocks impl close (inverse gate)
